title: SpaceX (SPCX) officially joins Nasdaq-100 today (July 7); ~$4.3B passive buying estimated from ETF rebalancing
summary: Space Exploration Technologies Corp (SPCX) joins the Nasdaq-100 effective July 7, just 15 trading days after its June 12 IPO — the fastest-ever inclusion under Nasdaq's new fast-track rule. JPMorgan estimates ~$4.3B in forced buying from QQQ/QQQM and other index-tracking funds.
why: Nasdaq-100重组触发约43亿美元被动买盘，QQQ/QQQM等主要科技ETF被动增持SPCX；指数权重稀释可能小幅影响其他成分股（含英伟达、谷歌、特斯拉）估值，卖出期权前需关注隐波短期波动。

title: US stocks July 6 close at all-time highs: S&P 500 +0.72% to 7,537; Dow Jones 53,055; Nasdaq +1.12% to 26,121
summary: US equities closed at fresh records on July 6. S&P 500: 7,537.43 (+0.72%), Dow Jones: 53,055.91 (+0.71%), Nasdaq Composite: 26,121.16 (+1.12%). State Street Technology Select Sector SPDR added nearly 2%. Hang Seng also closed +1.3% to 23,350.
why: 美股三指数续创历史新高，持仓估值整体受益；科技板块强势带动，英伟达/谷歌/特斯拉等持仓正向影响；高位震荡格局下sell put需注意下行保护与时间价值平衡。

title: Nvidia banned Blackwell AI servers selling for $1.1M on China's black market — double official price amid US export ban
summary: Nvidia's DGX B300 servers, banned from export to China, are trading at ~8 million yuan ($1.1M) on China's gray market, up from ~4 million yuan ($550K). The RTX 6000 Pro has also tripled in price to ~130,000 yuan. Demand reflects intense unmet AI compute need despite US restrictions. Originally reported by the Financial Times (June 24).
why: NVDA出口管制下中国需求未减反增，黑市溢价验证AI算力持续短缺叙事；短期利好NVDA持仓，同时中美技术脱钩加速，有望推动国内AI算力替代进程（利好相关A股/H股）。

title: Disney Q3 FY2026: Experiences revenue hits record $10.0B; streaming income soars +88% to $582M; net profit -6%; CEO Josh D'Amaro's first report
summary: Disney fiscal Q3 2026 (reported July 7): Experiences division delivered record quarterly revenue of $10.0B. Disney+/Hulu revenue rose 13% to $5.49B with operating income +88% to $582M (first 10%+ margin for streaming). Net profit $2.48B, down 6% YoY. Company warned of possible US consumer slowdown ahead.
why: DIS持仓直接受益：公园创纪录、流媒体首破双位数利润率，但净利下降6%且美国消费放缓警告带来下行风险；新CEO首报偏正面，但sell put策略需评估后续指引与隐波。

title: Interactive Brokers June 2026: DARTs +53% YoY to 5.27M, client equity +40% to $930.3B, margin loans +67% YoY
summary: Interactive Brokers reported June 2026 metrics: 5.269M Daily Average Revenue Trades (+53% YoY, +6% MoM), ending client equity $930.3B (+40% YoY), margin loan balances $108.5B (+67% YoY), and 5.185M client accounts (+34% YoY). Average commission $2.52 per cleared order.
why: 盈透证券IBKR业务数据全面加速，DARTs+53%与保证金贷款+67%均显著超越大盘增速；期权交易量强劲，直接利好IBKR持仓；市场杠杆快速上升需关注回调时系统性风险。

title: Kioxia and SanDisk (SNDK) begin mass production of 10th-generation 3D NAND flash memory at Kitakami, Japan
summary: SanDisk and Kioxia have started mass production of 10th-generation 3D NAND flash memory at the Fab2 facility in Kitakami, Japan. The expansion significantly increases capacity for enterprise AI servers, cloud infrastructure, and data-intensive applications.
why: 闪迪SNDK启动第10代3D NAND量产，直接强化AI存储市场供应能力，利于维持高毛利；年内股价已涨约490%，新产能上线降低供应风险；Bernstein目标价3000美元可能进一步上调。

title: Standard Chartered becomes first G-SIB to offer institutional USDC minting and redemption with Circle — launched in UAE/DIFC
summary: Standard Chartered and Circle announced July 2 that institutional clients can now mint and redeem USDC directly through Standard Chartered's onboarding, initially available via its DIFC (UAE) operations. Standard Chartered becomes the first global systemically important bank to offer such integrated stablecoin services, with plans to expand to more markets.
why: Circle CRCL里程碑级合作，全球首家G-SIB背书大幅提升USDC机构可信度；配合GENIUS Act合规叙事与BNY Mellon托管，Circle稳定币基础设施护城河持续加深，长线利好Circle持仓。
